project.description: The Angular application project to set up (defaults to the first application in angular.json).

routes.description: Path of the routes file, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to <sourceRoot>/app/app.routes.ts.

out.description: Path of the generated file, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to routes.gen.ts next to the routes file.

skipGenerate.description: Do not run the first generation.
